answer: In fiscal year 2022, American Express's total revenues net of interest expense were $52,862 million ($52.862 billion). Total non-interest revenues were $42,967 million, and total interest income was $12,658 million against total interest expense of $2,763 million (resulting in net interest income of $9,895 million).
rationale: The Consolidated Statements of Income in Item 8 of the 2022 10-K lists Total revenues net of interest expense as $52,862 million for the year ended December 31, 2022.
